description: For an admin of a charity livedot has verified: add a fundraising event (a ride, run, walk or adventure) to the charity's livedot page, with its date, start time and time zone (it has no end time), or change one before it starts (event_id). The first call (without confirm) only returns the plan: show it to the user and get one yes, then call again with the same details and confirm: true. Returns its page and the join link to send to fundraisers; reminders are on. A charity still being verified can't add events.

about.description: What it is, for its page (up to 1,000 characters).

charity.description: The charity's livedot address or name, when they run more than one.

confirm.description: true only after the user said yes to the plan this tool returned.

date.description: The start date, "YYYY-MM-DD", in the event's own time zone.

days.description: How many days it runs (1 if left out).

event_id.description: To change one of its events before it starts: its id from my_charity_team.

kind.description: A ride, a run, a walk or an adventure.

name.description: The event's name, e.g. "Christmas Eve Ride for Brightpath".

tz.description: The event's IANA time zone, e.g. "Africa/Johannesburg".

name: add_charity_event

outputSchema.description: The plan for a charity's new event (nothing made yet), or the event made and its join link.

app.description: The account's app (livedot for Good is on Windline).

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

event.description: The event: { id, name, kind, start, tz, place, url, phase, joined }.

made.description: With confirm: { id, url (its page), join_url (send it to fundraisers) }.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

plan.description: Without confirm: the event as it would be made ({ charity, event, reminders }); nothing made yet.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

state.description: What happened: preview, made, changed, pick, list, confirm, sent, none, joined, already, link, saved, removed or name.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Add a charity event
